notes: %calculate_KornGraubard_CIs computes Korn-Graubard (modified Clopper-Pearson) confidence intervals for complex-survey proportions and applies NCHS data-presentation suppression flags. The repo ships only the macro definition; this bundle adds a small caller that builds a 6-row mock SUDAAN Proc Descript output dataset (percent, sepercent, nsum, atlev1, atlev2) and calls the macro with default options (df_adjust=yes/NHANES), then prints the resulting CIs and flags. Mock values are illustrative, not real NHANES estimates.
